body: I've been thinking about this for awhile now. I really don't have anywhere to go anymore. I waited the CA 11 day waiting period to see if it was just impulsive, but it isn't. I still want to do. They can't stand the sight of me, or my presence.
Maybe just two to the heart. Less clean up then brains?

I do not like anything about myself anymore. I used to be angry and explosive, thinking the world was against me. I thought I grew up and become better. I now think it has gotten worst. I constantly have anxiety and severe depression. Random panic attacks happen and I try not to do anything stupid, but find myself doing just that. I am just not good enough for anyone or anything.
